slots.notes: Full-bleed object-cover looping background video behind each of the 3 category cards (autoplay, muted, playsInline); scales to 105% on card hover.

mechanic: IntersectionObserver one-shot reveal (opacity/translate-y over 1s) of a responsive 1→33-col grid of tall video-backed cards, each with index-staggered 150ms delay, a darkening hover overlay, hover-scaling video, and a vertically-rotated (writing-mode vertical-lr + rotate 180deg) lowercase category title.
techDelivery: plain React + Tailwind CSS component spec (utility classes inline, useInView IntersectionObserver hook, .btn-primary defined in the global stylesheet)
reskinNotes: Category data (name + CloudFront video URL) is hardcoded in an inline card array; the same lowercase name drives both the <h2> title and the CTA label via the literal pattern "shop {name}", so copy and asset binding are coupled. Title rendering depends on inline writingMode:'vertical-lr' + transform:rotate(180deg), which is font-metric/orientation sensitive. All copy is lowercase rendered as-is. Button hover/active shimmer and shadow rgba black values are baked into the .btn-primary CSS rather than tokens.
